title: fix(react,components,app-shell): a delegated admin's out-of-scope save shows the server's reason
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9SmSkP71JiVHXqMg5WDuVZY)_
Fixes #26190

Clause-②: yes (widening: `@object-ui/react` exports a new `delegationScopeMessage`)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：委派管理员在自己范围之外保存时（服务端回 `403 DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION`），记录表单的 toast 与表单横幅、以及 flow 运行失败提示，改为显示服务端给出的原因；其它所有拒绝照旧显示固定的「没有权限保存」。
- 为什么改：#26059 裁决 Q3 第 4 项。委派管理员需要知道是哪条边界（业务单元、权限集白名单、目标用户）拦下了操作，才能自己修正分配；原来所有 403 都被当成普通拒绝。
- 风险与回滚：只读这一个错误码，`PERMISSION_DENIED`、`FORBIDDEN`、裸 403、行级安全拒绝的分支不变（#24914 B′ 不变）；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.ts`（新函数 `delegationScopeMessage`）、`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`（错误文案取值链）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts`（`flowFailureMessage`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/react/src/utils/error-message.test.ts packages/components/src/__tests__/form-write-error-message.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/flowResponse.test.ts`，预期 3 个文件全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/react`**: new exported `delegationScopeMessage(err)`. It answers the server's reason, without the `[Security] ` machine prefix (via `extractWriteErrorMessage`), when the error's code is `DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION` (read from `code`, then `details.code`, the same pair `isPermissionError` reads, case-insensitive through `errorCodeIs`). It answers `null` for everything else, and for a scope refusal with no usable text. `isPermissionError` is unchanged and still answers true for any 403; its doc now says to ask the new reader first.
- **`@object-ui/components`** (record form): the message chain is `declaredUserMessage` → `delegationScopeMessage` → `isPermissionError ? form.noPermissionToSave : server text`. The toast and the in-form banner share the value.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`** (flow run path, `flowFailureMessage`): the inner refusal is asked for the scope reason before the permission check, so a write node that met the same refusal shows the same reason.
- Root changeset `.changeset/26190-delegation-scope-refusal-reason.md` (patch on the three packages).
- No sdui record. The per-package records were retired by #26367 while this PR was open. The main merge took the modify/delete with `git rm`, and CI's Build & E2E UI regenerates the manifest.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.test.ts`: `delegationScopeMessage` answers the reason for the client's 403 shape and for `details.code`; answers `null` for `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `FORBIDDEN`, a bare 403, a row-level-security message and `null`; answers `null` for a scope refusal with no text. One assertion pins why it must be asked first: `isPermissionError` answers true for the same error.
- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/form-write-error-message.test.tsx`: a scope refusal renders the reason without `[Security]` and without the fixed line; CONTROL: a plain `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` keeps the fixed line and withholds its text.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/flowResponse.test.ts`: the 400 `FLOW_FAILED` door and the 200 failed arm both show the reason; CONTROL on the same path: a `PERMISSION_DENIED` inner refusal still reads `form.noPermissionToSave`.
- No forced edits to existing tests.

## Acceptance notes

- **Flow site premise, measured.** On the flow path the inner refusal carries `code` and `message` but no status, and the scope reason does not match `isPermissionError`'s text pattern, so before this change the flow path already showed the server text, with its `[Security] ` prefix. The ablation shows exactly that: with the new line removed the test fails on the prefix, not on the fixed line. The explicit read makes the rule hold by code rather than by the text happening not to match, and makes the two sites render the same string.
- The card's note about the producer-side `userMessage` marking: not used. The ruled shape is the code; `userMessage` still wins when a producer sets it, as before.
- `delegationScopeMessage` is a new export of `@object-ui/react`, so the declaration is `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, re-declared at the seat's review (the claim first said `no`); the changeset carries the same line. Metadata-protocol stays `none` and the bump stays `patch`.
